strategy_c.relationship: New thesis derived from Strategy C findings. C is not reopened, re-decided or re-run.

xbrl_store.digest_scope: companyfacts/ documents and request ledgers only

data.pit_rule: A fact is readable only through the accession that carries it, and that accession must be a W_PRIMARY event of the candidate row. Facts from any other accession, and facts filed later, are never read.

excluded_classes_reason.E1: 8-K carries no XBRL fact (0 of 24 sampled accessions); contract value is text only; pool 193 rows is below the 300 floor
excluded_classes_reason.E3a: 8-K 2.02 carries no XBRL fact (0 of 251 sampled accessions); using a later 10-Q would be look-ahead

magnitude.accession_choice: earliest effective_time first, ties by accession number; the first accession that yields a comparable pair is used
magnitude.material_cut_basis: sample size only, fixed before any outcome was read: the >= +25% bucket holds 286 EM rows, below the 300 floor of section 19; the >= +10% cut holds 574
magnitude.excluded_from_gate: no sub-bucket, no negative bucket and no alternative cut can produce PASS

risk_filter.recent_dilution_20: C-E0 flag: a class E4 event in [D-20, D]
risk_filter.financing_event_60d: a class E4a..E4d event in [D-60, D] on the C-E0 event view
risk_filter.note: EM already excludes W_PRIMARY E4 by construction, so this filter only removes nearby financing history

cohorts.EM_REST: EM minus EQ2, the comparator of H2
cohorts.EQ_MATERIAL_RISK: (EQ2 and risk_filter) union (C-E0 status EM_NEGATIVE_RISK, observable, growth >= 0.10); reported separately, never merged into EQ2

outcomes.primary: close_return_5 = close(D+5) / open(D+1) - 1, excess over the matched control cells
outcomes.matched_control: C-M V1 cells (same date, price bucket, ATR bucket, dollar volume bucket), unchanged

statistics.estimator: C-M V1 _diff_ci: per signal date sum candidate outcomes and the control-cell means, then divide the totals
statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over the 240 primary signal dates
statistics.seed_note: a new seed for EQM-V0; the C-E0 seed 20260918 is not reused
statistics.multiplicity: H1 is one test at the 5 percent level. H2 and H3 form a union (either may satisfy the gate), so each is tested at 2.5 percent via the 97.5 percent two-sided interval, which is the Bonferroni correction for a union of two. H1 and the union are required together, an intersection-union structure that needs no further correction.

hypotheses.H1: EQ2 5D close excess > 0; point > 0 and the 95 percent CI lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H2: EQ2 5D close excess - EM_REST 5D close excess > 0; point > 0 and the 97.5 percent CI lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H3: EQ2 5D close excess - M_ONLY 5D close excess > 0; point > 0 and the 97.5 percent CI lower bound > 0
hypotheses.full_em_comparison: EQ2 versus all of EM is reported as well, but EM_REST is the declared comparator because EQ2 is a subset of EM

pre_outcome_checks.P1_timezone_audit: C-E0 timezone audit passes on its stored samples (UTC 40 of 40)
pre_outcome_checks.P3_basis: EM rows holding a periodic report whose quality status is not OBSERVABLE, divided by EM rows holding a periodic report; measured 0.0583
pre_outcome_checks.on_failure: GATE-EQM-V0 = INCONCLUSIVE, decided before any return is read; the floors are never lowered afterwards

checks: every used accession is a W_PRIMARY event of its own candidate row
every fact used carries that accession number
no fact whose accession lies outside W_PRIMARY changes any row
shifting every effective_time by +1 session changes only rows at a window edge
a synthetic accession accepted at close(D) + 1 second is detected (positive control)
pit_audit.violation_after_outcomes: the gate is FAIL for this declaration; a retry needs a new declaration

conditions.4_union_ci_low: the same comparison's 97.5 percent CI lower bound > 0
conditions.6_time_blocks: EQ2 excess > 0 in at least 3 of 4 blocks, and the gate-carrying difference > 0 in at least 3 of 4 blocks
conditions.7_sample: P4, P5, P6, P7 all pass
conditions.8_concentration: single ticker <= 0.05, top 5 tickers <= 0.15, single date <= 0.08, top 10 dates <= 0.40, and the point estimates of conditions 1 and 3 stay > 0 after leaving out the top 5 tickers, after leaving out the top 10 dates, and after leaving out each period label (Q, Y) in turn

gate.date_concentration_basis: earnings filings cluster into four reporting seasons: EQ2 spans 123 distinct dates of 240, single date share 0.054, top 10 dates 0.335, all measured before any outcome. The C-E0 caps of 0.05 and 0.25 would fail this cohort structurally rather than on evidence, so the caps are set at 0.08 and 0.40 and the leave-out requirements are strengthened instead
gate.scope_rule: the result is reported as the scope the data allows: periodic-report revenue magnitude, not event quality in general

ablation.after_results: EQ3 is not redefined, and durability or novelty are not added to this declaration

prohibitions: reading event text to infer meaning
changing the C-M thresholds or the C-E0 event windows
choosing the event class, the magnitude cut, the horizon or the window after seeing an outcome
trading backtester, entry or exit optimisation, stop loss, take profit, trailing, VWAP or pullback entry, position sizing
estimating data that does not exist, such as consensus EPS
lowering any floor in this file after an outcome is read
termination_rule: If GATE-EQM-V0 is FAIL, the event quality thesis in this form is closed. Threshold retuning, window changes, new scores, post-hoc event selection and horizon swaps are prohibited under this declaration. A different thesis needs a new research id and a new declaration.
